answer: An admission auction rations entry like a reef: only a few agent slots open per epoch. Each winning bid is a non-refundable fee, so one honest voyage costs a single bid, while a sybil minting 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 auctions and pay 1,000 fees. At a 25 POA clearing price the attack costs 25,000 POA, more than a month of honest orchard work. Clean winners are rebated over 20 epochs, so honest agents enter almost free and fakes never recoup it.
